BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE student_onboarding_path_admission (
    admission_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL,
    handoff_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    execution_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    state_ref_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (state_ref_kind IN ('accepted_draft','finalized_profile')),
    state_ref_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (state_ref_version >= 1),
    goal_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    goal_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    goal_graph_version VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('RESERVED','MATERIALIZED','ABORTED')),
    fence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (fence >= 1),
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    course_id UUID,
    assignment_id UUID,
    learning_path_id UUID,
    materialization_hash CHAR(64) CHECK (materialization_hash IS NULL OR materialization_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    abort_hash CHAR(64) CHECK (abort_hash IS NULL OR abort_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    abort_reason VARCHAR(32),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CHECK (updated_at >= created_at),
    CHECK ((status='RESERVED' AND course_id IS NULL AND assignment_id IS NULL AND learning_path_id IS NULL AND materialization_hash IS NULL AND abort_hash IS NULL AND abort_reason IS NULL) OR
           (status='MATERIALIZED' AND course_id IS NOT NULL AND assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND learning_path_id IS NOT NULL AND materialization_hash IS NOT NULL AND abort_hash IS NULL AND abort_reason IS NULL) OR
           (status='ABORTED' AND course_id IS NULL AND assignment_id IS NULL AND learning_path_id IS NULL AND materialization_hash IS NULL AND abort_hash IS NOT NULL AND abort_reason IN ('NO_GAP','STATE_CHANGED','ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS','CANCELLED')))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_student_onboarding_path_admission_live ON student_onboarding_path_admission(student_id) WHERE status='RESERVED';

CREATE TABLE student_onboarding_path_admission_operation (
    idempotency_key UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    admission_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES student_onboarding_path_admission(admission_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    operation_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (operation_kind IN ('RESERVE','RENEW','MATERIALIZE','ABORT')),
    request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    response_json JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(response_json)='object'),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (admission_id, operation_kind, request_hash)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION student_onboarding_path_admission_delete_guard() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'student onboarding path admission evidence is immutable'; END; $$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION student_onboarding_path_admission_update_guard() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    IF OLD.admission_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.admission_id OR OLD.student_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.student_id OR OLD.handoff_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.handoff_id OR OLD.execution_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.execution_id OR OLD.state_ref_kind IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.state_ref_kind OR OLD.state_ref_version IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.state_ref_version OR OLD.goal_code IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.goal_code OR OLD.goal_version IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.goal_version OR OLD.goal_graph_version IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.goal_graph_version OR OLD.request_hash IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.request_hash OR OLD.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.created_at THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'student onboarding path admission immutable fields changed';
    END IF;
    IF OLD.status = 'RESERVED' THEN
        IF NEW.status = 'RESERVED' AND NEW.fence = OLD.fence + 1 AND NEW.expires_at > OLD.expires_at AND NEW.updated_at >= OLD.updated_at AND NEW.course_id IS NULL AND NEW.assignment_id IS NULL AND NEW.learning_path_id IS NULL AND NEW.materialization_hash IS NULL AND NEW.abort_hash IS NULL AND NEW.abort_reason IS NULL THEN
            RETURN NEW;
        END IF;
        IF NEW.status = 'MATERIALIZED' AND NEW.fence = OLD.fence AND NEW.expires_at = OLD.expires_at AND NEW.updated_at >= OLD.updated_at AND NEW.course_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.learning_path_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.materialization_hash IS NOT NULL AND NEW.abort_hash IS NULL AND NEW.abort_reason IS NULL THEN
            RETURN NEW;
        END IF;
        IF NEW.status = 'ABORTED' AND NEW.fence = OLD.fence AND NEW.expires_at = OLD.expires_at AND NEW.updated_at >= OLD.updated_at AND NEW.course_id IS NULL AND NEW.assignment_id IS NULL AND NEW.learning_path_id IS NULL AND NEW.materialization_hash IS NULL AND NEW.abort_hash IS NOT NULL AND NEW.abort_reason IN ('NO_GAP','STATE_CHANGED','ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS','CANCELLED') THEN
            RETURN NEW;
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'student onboarding path admission transition is not allowed';
END; $$;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_student_onboarding_path_admission_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON student_onboarding_path_admission FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_onboarding_path_admission_delete_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_student_onboarding_path_admission_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON student_onboarding_path_admission FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_onboarding_path_admission_update_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_student_onboarding_path_admission_operation_delete_guard BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_onboarding_path_admission_operation FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_onboarding_path_admission_delete_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_student_onboarding_path_admission_truncate_guard BEFORE TRUNCATE ON student_onboarding_path_admission FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION student_onboarding_path_admission_delete_guard();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_student_onboarding_path_admission_operation_truncate_guard BEFORE TRUNCATE ON student_onboarding_path_admission_operation FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION student_onboarding_path_admission_delete_guard();
COMMIT;
